def fix_romanian(text: str) -> str:
    """
    Normalizes Romanian diacritics by replacing S-cedilla and T-cedilla 
    with the standard S-comma and T-comma characters.
    """
    replacements = {
        '\u015E': '\u0218',  # Ş (S-cedilla) -> Ș (S-comma)
        '\u015F': '\u021B',  # ş (s-cedilla) -> ș (s-comma)
        '\u01E8': '\u021A',  # Ţ (T-cedilla) -> Ț (T-comma)
        '\u01E9': '\u0219',  # ţ (t-cedilla) -> ț (t-comma)
    }
    return text.translate(str.maketrans(replacements))
